response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill_per_order FROM orderexecutions WHERE ordersmark IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_per_order) as global_avg FROM order_averages), first_filter AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_fill_per_order, oa.avg_fill_per_order - ga.global_avg as margin_over_global FROM order_averages oa CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE oa.avg_fill_per_order > ga.global_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_per_order) as group_avg FROM first_filter), final_filter AS (SELECT ff.ordersmark, ff.avg_fill_per_order, ff.margin_over_global, ff.avg_fill_per_order - ga.group_avg as margin_over_group FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN group_avg ga WHERE ff.avg_fill_per_order > ga.group_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_fill_per_order) as final_avg_fill_size, AVG(margin_over_global) as avg_margin_over_global, AVG(margin_over_group) as avg_margin_over_group FROM final_filter;
